content.title: What channel is the Brewers game today for opening day? TV, stream
content.text: Updated March 26, 2026, 1:12 p.m. CT(Note: This story has been updated with new information.)A new season of Milwaukee Brewers baseball has arrived.Can they find that magic again in 2026?The Brewers are coming off a season in which they captivated the city and fanbase when they advanced to the National League Championship Series, won a third straight NL Central Division title, set a franchise record in season victories and had its longest winning streak during a summer to remember.Many familiar faces return, including the likes of veterans like Christian Yelich, Brandon Woodruff and William Contreras, rising stars like Jackson Chourio, Brice Turang and the season-opening starter Jacob Misiorowski, to go with two-time Manager of the Year Pat Murphy back in charge.The Brewers kick off their 2026 season at home on Thursday, March 26, for opening day against the Chicago White Sox.The new season also brings about a new way to watch the Brewers with a new channel and streaming option.Here's how to watch the Brewers on opening day, including on TV, live stream and the schedule.What time is the Brewers game today? Brewers vs White Sox opening day start timeTime: 1:10 p.m.Date: Thursday, March 26The Milwaukee Brewers play the Chicago White Sox in the 2026 season opener at American Family Field.Brewers game on TV: Where to watch the Brewers on Opening DayFan Duel Sports is no longer the home of Brewers TV. With MLB distributing Brewers games now, there's a new way to access games on TV.The Brewers just announced Thursday morning the channel information for cable and satellite TV services.The club said channels include 1263 on XFinity, 670 on DirecTV, 1743 on U-Verse.For Spectrum customers, the channel varies, depending on the local system – check 308, 1308, 319, 317 and 469 for the channel or channels in your community.The broadcasts are also listed as available on streaming service Fubo, which offers a free trial for new subscribers.The Brewers are pointing fans to a channel-finding tool on their web site at Brewers.com/watch for a full list.In the moments after the announcement, the channel finder wasn't yet locating details for Spectrum customers for Milwaukee-area zip codes, but that was fixed later in the morning.Opening Day will also air for free on Fox (Channel 6) in Milwaukee and other channels around Wisconsin as one of 10 games this season on over-the-air TV.Stream MLB.TV on ESPN UnlimitedHow to watch Brewers game on live streamIn the Brewers home television territory, the MLB streaming option will be through Brewers.TV with no blackouts (subject to national exclusives).Here are the packages available:Brewers.TV Seasonal Package: $99.99Brewers.TV & MLB.TV Package: $199.99Brewers.TV Monthly Package: $19.99Brewers.TV & MLB.TV Monthly Package: $39.99Can I watch today's Brewers game for free?Yes, the Brewers game today and nine others during the season will be broadcast on "over the air" television.In Milwaukee, the Opening Day game will be on WITI-TV (Channel 6). The Brewers.TV live stream option also include a seven-day free trial.Here are the free "over the air" games in 2026:March 26: vs. Chicago White Sox, 1:10 p.m.March 31: vs. Tampa Bay Rays, 6:40 p.m.April 28: vs. Arizona Diamondbacks, 6:40 p.m.May 12: vs. San Diego Padres, 6:40 p.m.May 19: at Chicago Cubs, 6:40 p.m.June 2: vs. San Francisco Giants, 6:40 p.m.Aug. 4: vs. Pittsburgh Pirates, 6:40 p.m.Aug. 18: vs. Seattle Mariners, 6:40 p.m.Aug. 25: at New York Mets, 6:10 p.m.Sept. 8: vs. Chicago Cubs, 6:40 p.m.Who are the Brewers announcers?Brian Anderson and Jeff Levering will handle play-by-play, alongside analysts Bill Schroeder, Tim Dillard and Vinny Rottino. Sophia Minnaert will again be the sideline reporter.What is the Brewers radio station?Brewers games air on the Brewers Radio Network across the state, with AM-620 WTMJ the flagship station.Here's a list of the radio stations.Milwaukee Brewers ticketsTickets are available on the StubHub but are selling fast.As of Wednesday, March 25, the cheapest seat was $49, including fees, in section 425. Others in the Terrace Level were in the $50-$80 range.Seats in the Field Outfield are closer to $100, while seats in the Field Infield are between $130-$150.The most expensive tickets are in the Field Diamond Platinum area going for as high as $505.Buy Brewers tickets on StubHubBrewers vs White Sox probable pitchersBrewers right-handed pitcher Jacob Misiorowski, who set the baseball world by storm last season on his way to an All-Star Game appearance after only five career starts, gets the ball on opening day.In 15 games, the 23-year-old Misiorowski posted a 5-3 record with a 4.36 ERA and 1.24 WHIP.For the White Sox, it's right-handed Shane Smith, a player whom the Brewers actually selected in the 2021 MLB Draft. The 25-year-old started 29 games last season and posted a 7-8 record with a 3.81 ERA and 1.20 WHIP.Brewers scheduleAfter Thursday's opener, there is a day off on Friday, March 27, before the three-game series resumes on Saturday, March 28. The Brewers remain at home for another three-game set in their second series of the season against the Tampa Bay Rays.Brewers vs. White Sox, 1:10 p.m. Thursday, March 26Brewers vs. White Sox, 6:10 p.m. Saturday, March 28Brewers vs. White Sox, 1:10 p.m. Sunday, March 29Brewers vs. Rays, 6:40 p.m. Monday, March 30Brewers vs. Rays, 6:40 p.m. Tuesday, March 31Brewers vs. Rays, 12:40 p.m. Wednesday, April 1
